mapper.select: INSERT INTO public.attendance_day ( department_id, attendance_date, policy_version_id, finalization_due_at, status, created_by_account_id ) VALUES ( #{departmentId}, #{attendanceDate}, #{policyVersionId}, #{finalizationDueAt}, 'SCHEDULED', #{actorAccountId} ) ON CONFLICT (department_id, attendance_date) DO NOTHING RETURNING id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.attendance_target ( attendance_day_id, member_id, department_id, membership_id, is_target, added_source ) SELECT #{attendanceDayId}, membership.member_id, membership.department_id, membership.id, TRUE, 'SNAPSHOT' FROM public.department_membership AS membership JOIN public.member AS member ON member.id = membership.member_id AND member.active WHERE membership.department_id = #{departmentId} AND membership.ended_at IS NULL ORDER BY membership.member_id
mapper.select: SELECT day.id, day.department_id, day.attendance_date, day.policy_version_id, day.status, policy.check_in_start_time, day.finalization_due_at FROM public.attendance_day AS day JOIN public.attendance_policy_version AS policy ON policy.id = day.policy_version_id AND policy.department_id = day.department_id WHERE day.id = #{attendanceDayId} AND day.department_id = #{departmentId} FOR UPDATE OF day

SELECT day.id, day.department_id, day.attendance_date, day.policy_version_id, day.status, policy.check_in_start_time, day.finalization_due_at FROM public.attendance_day AS day JOIN public.attendance_policy_version AS policy ON policy.id = day.policy_version_id AND policy.department_id = day.department_id JOIN public.attendance_target AS target ON target.attendance_day_id = day.id AND target.department_id = day.department_id WHERE day.department_id = #{departmentId} AND target.member_id = #{memberId} AND target.is_target AND day.status = 'SCHEDULED' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.attendance_record AS record WHERE record.attendance_day_id = day.id ) AND ( day.attendance_date > #{today} OR (day.attendance_date = #{today} AND policy.check_in_start_time > #{currentTime}) ) ORDER BY day.id FOR UPDATE OF day, target
SELECT id FROM public.attendance_day WHERE status = 'SCHEDULED' AND finalization_due_at <= #{now} ORDER BY finalization_due_at, id

SELECT min( CASE WHEN finalization_lease_until > #{now} THEN finalization_lease_until ELSE COALESCE(finalization_next_attempt_at, finalization_due_at) END) FROM public.attendance_day WHERE status = 'SCHEDULED' AND finalization_failure_count < 6

SELECT id FROM public.attendance_day WHERE status = 'SCHEDULED' AND finalization_failure_count < 6 AND COALESCE(finalization_next_attempt_at, finalization_due_at) <= #{now} AND (finalization_lease_until IS NULL OR finalization_lease_until <= #{now}) ORDER BY COALESCE(finalization_next_attempt_at, finalization_due_at), id LIMIT #{limit}

UPDATE public.attendance_day SET finalization_claim_version = finalization_claim_version + 1, finalization_lease_until = #{leaseUntil} WHERE id = #{attendanceDayId} AND status = 'SCHEDULED' AND finalization_failure_count < 6 AND COALESCE(finalization_next_attempt_at, finalization_due_at) <= #{now} AND (finalization_lease_until IS NULL OR finalization_lease_until <= #{now}) RETURNING id AS attendance_day_id, finalization_failure_count AS failure_count, finalization_claim_version AS claim_version
mapper.update: UPDATE public.attendance_day SET finalization_failure_count = #{failureCount}, finalization_next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt}, finalization_lease_until = NULL, finalization_first_failed_at = COALESCE( finalization_first_failed_at, #{failedAt}), finalization_last_error_code = #{errorCode}, finalization_last_failed_at = #{failedAt} WHERE id = #{attendanceDayId} AND status = 'SCHEDULED' AND finalization_claim_version = #{claimVersion}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.attendance_record ( attendance_day_id, policy_version_id, member_id, status, source ) SELECT day.id, day.policy_version_id, target.member_id, 'ABSENT', 'AUTO_ABSENCE' FROM public.attendance_day AS day JOIN public.attendance_target AS target ON target.attendance_day_id = day.id AND target.department_id = day.department_id AND target.is_target LEFT JOIN public.attendance_record AS record ON record.attendance_day_id = target.attendance_day_id AND record.member_id = target.member_id WHERE day.id = #{attendanceDayId} AND day.status = 'SCHEDULED' AND record.id IS NULL ON CONFLICT (attendance_day_id, member_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE public.attendance_day SET status = 'FINALIZED', finalized_at = #{finalizedAt}, finalization_lease_until = NULL, finalization_next_attempt_at = NULL WHERE id = #{attendanceDayId} AND status = 'SCHEDULED'
